guide.verdict: Easiest: Internal tool in one workspace (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Marketplace-listed commercial AI agent (app review).

composio.note: Composio manages a Slack OAuth app, which is fine for prototypes. For production, Composio recommends your own credentials for Slack.

need_own_app.answer: For a prototype, no: Composio's managed Slack app works. For production, yes. Users would otherwise see Composio's name on the consent screen, and the managed app shares its quota across all Composio users.
reasons: Show your own app name on the consent screen instead of Composio's
Dedicated quota instead of one shared across all Composio users
Marketplace listing is tied to your own Slack app, which is the route Slack requires for commercial distribution
